title: Tverberg's Partition Theorem, 1D Theorem, and Colorful 1D Theorem
abstract: A complete, machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of Tverberg's Theorem (Helge Tverberg, 1966) in the distinct-point set formulation across dimensions d >= 1 (with d = 0, r > 1 cases vacuously satisfied due to Finset carrier capacity limits on Fin 0 -> ℝ) via the Sarkaria–Bárány Colorful Carathéodory reduction, the full 1D Tverberg theorem for arbitrary r via symmetric-rank pairing following Mulzer–Werner, and the 1-dimensional Colorful Tverberg Theorem for arbitrary r (Bárány–Larman–Pach 1992). Proves that any (r - 1)(d + 1) + 1 points in ℝ^d can be partitioned into r parts whose convex hulls intersect, and that two disjoint color classes of r points each in ℝ¹ can be partitioned into r colorful pairs whose convex hulls share a common point of intersection. To the maintainers' knowledge, the theorem was not found in an exact declaration name, docstring, and type signature search of the pinned Mathlib revision (Mathlib v4.34.0-rc1).
